descriptions.value: In onActivityResult of AppWidgetConfigActivityProxy.java, there is a possible unauthorized URI permission grant due to a confused deputy. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
Improper access control in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.
